# Ulanzi SDK static analysis fixtures

Unmodified selected text files from the UlanziTechnology/UlanziDeckPlugin-SDK repository at commit `550ab80c69285ecf259bd494a7fff767c14f0c0f`. Upstream source paths and Git blob IDs are in `sources.json`. The upstream Apache-2.0 LICENSE is included. These are incomplete analysis fixtures, not installable plugins. No imported script, HTML, dependency, bundled executable or resource is executed. Original source names are preserved in provenance; the local directory is flattened for test use.
